mira (sec-eng): Heads-up: starting role-affinity shard migration at 11:30 PT. This will consolidate legacy role_bindings -> role_affinity. tagging @sam @anne @leo for rollout.

sam (db): 👍 what's the canary plan? which shards first?

anne (infra): Canary on shard-0 (1% of users) for 15m, then shard-2 (10%) for 30m, then shard-7 full. We'll rate-limit background workers during backfill.

leo (sre): Add a circuit-breaker on lock time > 5s. If we see > 2x baseline QPS error rate rollback automatically.

mira (sec-eng): Important: new role_affinity rows include kms_wrapped_key_id for per-role keys. security-oncall please confirm KMS policy readiness.

security-oncall: Confirmed — KMS key policy allows decrypt for service-account:redwood-rbac. Note: rotate-preview keys not allowed during migration window.

sam (db): Migration SQL preview:
```
BEGIN;
INSERT INTO role_affinity (user_id, role_id, attrs, kms_wrapped_key_id)
SELECT rb.user_id, rb.role_id, rb.attrs, 'key:projects/redwood/keys/rbac-v1' FROM role_bindings rb
WHERE rb.created_at < now() - interval '30 days' AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM role_affinity ra WHERE ra.user_id = rb.user_id AND ra.role_id = rb.role_id
);
COMMIT;
```
Keep chunk_size=5k rows.

anne (infra): We'll run chunks with a pause of 30s between. Monitoring: pg_locks, cpu, p99 latency. Also push a temporary feature-flag to prevent new writes to legacy table during final cutover.

leo (sre): Set up alerts:
- pg_locks.waiting > 5 for 60s
- api.errors.p50 > baseline*2 for 3m
- audit.missing_kms_id > 0
If triggered, pause migration and notify channel.

mira (sec-eng): Audit log change: new field role_affinity.kms_wrapped_key_id will be included in audit entries. sample query to validate post-migration:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM audit_logs al
WHERE al.resource_type = 'role_affinity' AND al.payload LIKE '%kms_wrapped_key_id%';
```

security-oncall: Also remember to tag audit entries with obfuscation flag for PII.

sam (db): Running canary now on shard-0. job id: rb-mig-canary-2412506789

deploy-bot: Canary job rb-mig-canary-2412506789 started on shard-0 at 2026-03-20T18:30:45Z :rocket:

leo (sre): Canary smoke: no lock spikes, p99 latency +3% (within threshold), audit entries contain kms_wrapped_key_id. continuing to shard-2.

anne (infra): Shard-2 in progress. I'm throttling background workers to 25% during heavy ranges.

mira (sec-eng): Reminder: if audit.missing_kms_id > 0 after canary, we must abort and run reconciliation script.

sam (db): Noted. Also there was a rare case in staging where NULL attrs caused duplicate detection to skip. I'll add coalesce(attrs,'{}') in dedupe.

mira (sec-eng): Good catch. Apply patch before shard-7. If anything weird, we'll rollback to read-only write for legacy table and run manual reconcile.

security-oncall: After full roll, schedule an eval to ensure no regressed entitlements. I'll add regression alert set.

mira (sec-eng): Thanks team. Leaving channel open during cutover. Ping if you see anything odd. :eyes:
